entry.title: Wave Forcing: Towards Speed-of-Light Streaming Video Generation. Real-time long-video generation requires continuous output with consistent appearance and natural motion.
entry.summary:
Real-time long-video generation requires continuous output with consistent appearance and natural motion. Existing chunk-wise autoregressive methods face challenges in both generation efficiency and long-video quality: serialized denoising and history-cache refresh require two forward passes even with one-step denoising, and longer rollouts can degrade quality and cause camera drift. We propose Wave Forcing (WF), which co-designs generation, training, and execution for continuous video output with multi-step denoising.

Source: Hugging Face Daily Papers · Tags: #llm #open-weights

entry.title: CoworkOS:Scaling Agent Coworkers for Real-world Automation
entry.summary:
Rapid advances in cowork agents are shifting human-AI collaboration toward real-world automation, delivering software, designs, and other artifacts. However, such productivity work demands both high-quality delivery on complex productivity tasks and continued monitoring and decision-making over long horizons, a combination that remains an open challenge. We introduce CoworkOS, a general-purpose harness for long-horizon work that separates task strategy from execution management: the model decides actions, delegation, and acceptance, while the runtime maintains state and feedback.

Source: Hugging Face Daily Papers · Tags: #llm #open-weights #agents

entry.title: CUA-Master: Scaling Computer-use Agents through Open-World Recursive Improvements
entry.summary:
Despite recent advances in CUAs, their development remains constrained by the limited diversity, controllability, and reliability of interaction data. Moreover, conventional optimization pipelines lack iterative feedback, while existing recursive improvement approaches often rely on self-generated experiences, limiting ability expansion and yielding diminishing returns. To address these challenges, we introduce CUA-Master, a nested double-loop recursive improvement framework.

Source: Hugging Face Daily Papers · Tags: #llm #open-weights #agents

entry.title: Democratizing Robot-Use Agents: A Unified Harness with Open Models
entry.summary:
Robot-use Agents (RUAs) have shown promising zero-shot manipulation capabilities, but reliance on frontier, proprietary models limits research into further training. To democratize RUA research, we introduce uni-robot-agent, a unified harness for competitive open-weight robot use that supports further training. Without privileged inputs, an out-of-the-box Qwen3.8-Flash-Next achieves a RoboDojo Score of 31.39, surpassing the published GPT-6 Astra-RoboProbe result of 28.97 and many VLA/WAM baselines, and performs competitively on 19 real-world tasks.

Source: Hugging Face Daily Papers · Tags: #llm #open-weights #agents #robotics

entry.title: Reviso: Not All Visual Evidence Deserves Equal Attention in Video Captioning
entry.summary:
Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can generate detailed video captions, yet they may overemphasize minor details while overlooking essential context and key events. We argue that not all visual evidence deserves equal attention, as the importance of visual information depends on the content of each video. Motivated by this observation, we propose Reviso, an agentic video captioning framework that learns what to observe and how to gather relevant visual evidence.

Source: Hugging Face Daily Papers · Tags: #llm #open-weights #agents

entry.title: NorthCUA Technical Report: Turbocharging Computer-Use Agents through Experience at Scale
entry.summary:
Scaling computer-use agents from individual actions to complex software work requires experience that connects decisions to complete outcomes. We present NorthCUA, an integrated system for turbocharging computer-use agents through experience at scale. Its Experience Flywheel supplies diverse executable tasks to the NorthCUA Harness, which sustains long interactions, records decisions, and checks task outcomes.

Source: Hugging Face Daily Papers · Tags: #llm #open-weights #agents #reinforcement-learning

entry.title: PhotoGuider: Composition-Aware Cropping and 360^{circ} View Framing with Explainable Photographic Assessments
entry.summary:
Traditional image cropping assumes the photograph already contains the composition worth keeping, and asks only where to crop. A full 360^{circ} scene offers no such guarantee: the viewing direction in a scene has to be discovered before anything can be framed. We present PhotoGuider, a measure-then-frame method that answers both questions with compact learned scorers over one shared set of composition-aware features.

Source: Hugging Face Daily Papers · Tags: #llm #open-weights #combinatorics

entry.title: Advances in Agentic Computer Graphics. Computer graphics is built on code.
entry.summary:
Computer graphics is built on code. Large language model (LLM) agents can now generate graphics code and iteratively refine it through various feedback. This capability opens the door to a potentially new paradigm of computer graphics, with graphics algorithms increasingly built around agentic systems to automate progressively complex tasks.

Imagine halving the resource costs of AI and what that could mean for the planet and the industry -- based on extreme estimates such savings could reduce the total US power usage by over 10% by 2030 1 . entry.title: KlaskTron: An Open-Source Platform for Physical Adversarial Multi-Agent RL
entry.summary:
Understanding mobility dynamics and the effects of urban transportation management policies requires examining how individual travel decisions, traffic conditions, and policy interventions influence one another over time. We present AgenticMobility, an open-source experimental platform for studying how mobility AI agents and other AI agents interact, adapt through repeated experience, and collectively shape mobility outcomes. Persistent agents retain identities and relevant states across rounds, with explicit interfaces defining information access, admissible actions, and decision schedules; linked records trace decisions, execution, and feedback.

entry.title: $C^1$-rigidity of $\mathbb{H}^{p,q}$-convex cocompact representations of Gromov hyperbolic groups
entry.summary:
Let $p>3$ and let $Γ$ be a non-elementary Gromov hyperbolic group with $\partial_\inftyΓ\cong\mathbb S^{p-1}$. We prove that every $\mathbb{H}^{p,2}$-convex cocompact representation $$ ρ:Γ\longrightarrow \mathrm{PO}_{p,3} $$ whose proximal limit set $Λ_ρ\subset\partial_\infty\mathbb{H}^{p,2}$ is a $C^1$ submanifold preserves a totally geodesic copy of $\mathbb{H}^p\subset\mathbb{H}^{p,2}$. Consequently, $Γ/\ker ρ$ is virtually a cocompact lattice in $\mathrm{Isom}(\mathbb{H}^p)$.

Source: arXiv Mathematics (NT, CO, AG, LO, AT, GR) · Tags: #number-theory #combinatorics #algebra-geometry #analysis-pde

This gives a quantitative strengthening of the finiteness theorems of Bader--Fisher--Miller--Stover (Invent. Math., 2023) and Baldi--Ullmo (Ann.

entry.title: On inverse aggregate network assignment games
entry.summary:
To design platforms for multi-operator mobility markets coordinating their operations or infrastructure to support them, models are needed to understand the behavior of these operators and travelers in a shared network. Assignment games can prove useful, but operationalizing them requires adopting a more generalized aggregate assignment game framework that allows for identification and estimation. We extend such a framework to aggregate network assignment games, proposing a path-based formulation and a PURC-based formulation along with solution algorithms.

Source: arXiv Economics (econ.EM, econ.GN, econ.TH) · Tags: #econometrics #macroeconomics #decision-theory #market-design

entry.title: Classification Aggregation with Multiple Memberships. People face the problem of classifying objects into categories while aggregating their opinions.
entry.summary:
People face the problem of classifying objects into categories while aggregating their opinions. We axiomatically study such a classification aggregation problem with multiple memberships, meaning that each individual assigns one category to every object, whereas the resulting classification may assign more than one category. Under the natural settings and axioms (i.e., Independence and Supportiveness), each of our new axioms -- Responsibility, Split Stability and Rejection Stability -- characterises what we call the junta rules.

Source: arXiv Economics (econ.EM, econ.GN, econ.TH) · Tags: #econometrics #macroeconomics #market-design #decision-theory

entry.title: Persuasion by Parts. Classical Bayesian persuasion assumes that an information designer can condition signals on the entire state.
entry.summary:
Classical Bayesian persuasion assumes that an information designer can condition signals on the entire state. We propose persuasion by parts. In this model, the receiver's payoff from acting is $X = \sum_{i=1}^n X_i$ for independent coordinates $X_1,\ldots,X_n$ observed by separate sources.

Source: arXiv Economics (econ.EM, econ.GN, econ.TH) · Tags: #econometrics #macroeconomics #decision-theory #market-design

entry.title: Mutual information to all orders from modular flow: a replica-free approach
entry.summary:
We derive an all-orders long-distance expansion of vacuum mutual information between two disjoint balls in generic $d$-dimensional CFTs. The derivation uses a novel radial sewing expansion of the joint vacuum density matrix, together with a modular response formula for relative entropy and the geometric modular flow of a single ball, without analytic continuation in replica number. The expansion coefficients are modular integrals of modular-flowed vacuum correlators.

Source: arXiv Quantum & Condensed Matter (quant-ph, cond-mat) · Tags: #quantum-computing #condensed-matter #high-energy #post-quantum

entry.title: Single-pass stochastic cooling for electron microscopy
entry.summary:
Scientific applications of free electrons, such as in electron microscopes and particle accelerators, are limited by the brightness of available electron sources. Accelerators can use phase space cooling to surpass these source limitations, whereas electron microscopes can only rely on particle filtering to increase beam coherence at the cost of reduced brightness. We show that strong electron-light coupling in nanophotonic structures makes it possible to achieve single-pass stochastic cooling inside an electron microscope for a lossless improvement of longitudinal emittance.

Source: arXiv Quantum & Condensed Matter (quant-ph, cond-mat) · Tags: #quantum-computing #condensed-matter #optics-photonics

entry.title: The Virasoro Bootstrap: from the $c\sim1$ desert to coupled Potts
entry.summary:
We develop a numerical conformal bootstrap for two-dimensional CFTs with $c>1$ based on Virasoro conformal blocks, computed with Zamolodchikov's recursion and optimal polynomial interpolation. As a first test we isolate an island around three decoupled Ising models. We then consider three 3-state Potts models coupled through their energy operators, a candidate irrational CFT.

Source: arXiv Quantum & Condensed Matter (quant-ph, cond-mat) · Tags: #quantum-computing #condensed-matter #high-energy

entry.title: Symmetry breaking from conformality loss on holographic Rényi defects. The Rényi entropies of a ball are computed by a conformal defect, the Rényi defect, dual in holography to a hyperbolic black hole.
entry.summary:
The Rényi entropies of a ball are computed by a conformal defect, the Rényi defect, dual in holography to a hyperbolic black hole. At an index $n_*$ its charged operator merges with its alternate-quantization partner, and the defect loses conformality. Beyond $n_*$ it flows with no source to a conformal defect that breaks the U(1) symmetry; below $n_*$ that defect needs a symmetry-breaking source, so at large $N$, conformality loss makes the breaking spontaneous.

Source: arXiv Quantum & Condensed Matter (quant-ph, cond-mat) · Tags: #quantum-computing #condensed-matter #high-energy #astrophysics

entry.title: Lee-Yang theorems for $q$-deformed oscillators and doubly-scaled SYK
entry.summary:
We show that the vacuum partition function of the $q$-deformed oscillator $$ L_q(z):= \langle0|e^{zT_q}|0\rangle, \qquad T_q := \mathsf{a}_q + \mathsf{a}_q^* $$ satisfies the Lee-Yang property, i.e., all zeros of $L_q$ lie on the imaginary line for all $q\in[-1, 1)$, proving the conjectures of Okuyama'23. Using the connection between $q$-deformed oscillators and the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) Hamiltonian in the doubly-scaled regime, we show that the annealed SYK partition function satisfies the Lee-Yang property in the thermodynamic limit, that is, all of its Fisher zeros are on the imaginary axis. As a result, we show that the quenched SYK partition function admits a zero-free strip of constant width with high probability, rigorously complementing the large$-k$ replica calculations of Zlokapa and Kiani'26.

Source: arXiv Analysis, PDEs & Probability (AP, PR, NA, OC) · Tags: #analysis-pde #probability-stats #quantum-computing #logic

entry.title: The Merck/Moderna Results
entry.summary:
This is one of those times - and there are many - when you should evaluate a biopharma news story based on the science and not on the stock market. I’m referring to the clinical trial data that Merck and Moderna released yesterday for their vaccine (intismeran autogene)/Keytruda combination in melanoma patients after surgery. That should probably read “released under duress”, because the data leaked in advance of a meeting presentation, and the companies were more or less forced to press-release on the numbers.

Source: In the Pipeline (Derek Lowe — Drug Discovery & Chemistry) · Tags: #genomics-proteins #materials-science
